blocks.text: A randomly selected chronic condition. It uses the category’s existing penalties and treatment.
Location: Any location with this category
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Targeted chronic treatment; rest alone does not cure the condition.
Story connection: No fixed location storyline; ordinary cases may appear wherever the category roll succeeds.
